### web/app/views/chat/index.html.erb

`````html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="<%= I18n.locale %>">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover, user-scalable=no">
  <%= csrf_meta_tags %>
  <%= csp_meta_tag %>
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#000000">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
  <meta name="master-runtime" content="face">
  <meta name="master-tier" content="<%= @tier.to_s %>">
  <meta name="master-profile" content="<%= @profile.to_s %>">
  <meta name="master-visual-profile" content="auto">
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
  <meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
  <title><%= t("face.title") %></title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Crect width='32' height='32' fill='%23030303'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='16' cy='16' r='7' fill='%23fff'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
  <link rel="manifest" href="<%= pwa_manifest_path(format: :json) %>">
  <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="<%= asset_path("icon.png") %>">
  <script nonce="<%= content_security_policy_nonce %>">
    // Deferred-boot contract, enforced at the platform level: no WebGL context may be
    // created before the primer tap. THREE.js parse + WebGL init is heavy enough
    // to wedge the main thread; if a stale or regressed asset boots it at page load, the
    // "tap to start" handler never runs and the tap looks dead (recurring bug: 930a35ca5,
    // a9aa0a6f6, f9b6aa57e). 2D canvases (cognition ecology) are untouched. After the tap
    // (_primerFired), getContext behaves normally, so the real face still boots on tap.
    (function () {
      var proto = window.HTMLCanvasElement && HTMLCanvasElement.prototype;
      if (!proto || proto.__masterWebglGuard) return;
      proto.__masterWebglGuard = true;
      var original = proto.getContext;
      proto.getContext = function (type) {
        if (!window._primerFired && /webgl/i.test(String(type))) return null;
        return original.apply(this, arguments);
      };
    })();
    <%# Rendered from config/face_assets.yml — the one manifest. The eager list
        and the path map used to be two hand-maintained literals repeating the
        same twelve names, free to drift apart; the map is now derived. %>
    window.MASTER_ASSET_PATHS = {
      faceModulesList: <%= raw FaceAssets.eager.to_json %>,
      faceModules: <%= raw FaceAssets.module_names.to_h { |name| [name, asset_path(name)] }.to_json %>,
      <%= raw FaceAssets.singletons.map { |key, file| "#{key}: #{asset_path(file).to_json}" }.join(",\n      ") %>
    };
  </script>
  <script nonce="<%= content_security_policy_nonce %>">
    <% persona = Rails.application.config.x.master_container&.[](:personality) %>
    <% profile = persona.respond_to?(:browser_profile) ? persona.browser_profile : {} %>
    window.MASTER_PERSONA = <%= raw profile.to_json %>;
    window.MASTER_VOICE_POLICY = <%= raw Master::Voice::Policy.browser_payload.to_json %>;
    window.MASTER_SOUL_SUMMARY = "persona <%= persona&.name || 'anchor' %>; voice <%= Master::Voice::Policy.neural_voice %> (TTS fixed; persona affects text only); constitutional face";
    window.MASTER_RUNTIME = <%= raw Master::Ground::RuntimeCatalog.web_boot_payload_minimal.to_json %>;
    window.MASTER_COMMANDS = <%= raw Master::CLI::CommandRegistry.command_surface.to_json %>;
    window.MASTER_I18N = <%= raw t("face.js").to_json %>;
    window.MASTER_T = function (key, fallback, vars) {
      var text = window.MASTER_I18N && typeof window.MASTER_I18N[key] === "string" ? window.MASTER_I18N[key] : fallback;
      return vars ? text.replace(/%\{(\w+)\}/g, function (_, name) { return vars[name]; }) : text;
    };
  </script>
  <link rel="preload" href="<%= asset_path("face.css") %>" as="style">
  <%# No prefetch of face.js or THREE — on a 1-CPU VPS it competes with primer tap on the main thread. %>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="<%= asset_path("face.css") %>">
  <%# chat upload widget CSS isn't needed for the initial primer/face paint --
      defer it off the render-blocking path (inline onload= is blocked by CSP here).
      DOMContentLoaded applies it too: a preload that finished before the listener
      was attached never fires load again, and a preload link has no sheet to test. %>
  <link rel="preload" as="style" id="chat-upload-css" href="<%= asset_path("chat_upload.css") %>">
  <noscript><link rel="stylesheet" href="<%= asset_path("chat_upload.css") %>"></noscript>
  <script nonce="<%= content_security_policy_nonce %>">
    (function(){var f=document.getElementById('chat-upload-css');if(!f)return;
      var on=function(){f.rel='stylesheet';};
      f.addEventListener('load',on);document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',on);})();
  </script>
  <style nonce="<%= content_security_policy_nonce %>">
    html, body { background: #000; color: #d8d6e0; } /* scan: intentional-colors — painted before any stylesheet loads; the FOUC guard cannot cite what has not arrived */
    canvas#face { display: block; position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #000; } /* scan: intentional-colors — same FOUC guard: the canvas ground exists before the stylesheet */
    #primer { background: transparent; }
    #zsh { background: #000; }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="zen face-loading"
      data-layout="face"
      data-surface="face"
      data-runtime-profile="boot"
      data-runtime-visible="true"
      data-visual-runtime="face"
      data-theme="dark"
      data-profile="<%= @profile.to_s %>"
      data-aesthetic="<%= Master::Voice::Aesthetic.mode %>"
      <%# "keep" holds the primer up rather than autostarting past it, for a
          surface whose welcome screen is the point and which wants the tap as
          the user gesture an AudioContext needs. No host asks for that today. %>
      data-primer="auto">
  <a href="#zin" class="skip-link"><%= t("skip_to_prompt") %></a>
  <%# The same wordmark the three RAILS apps carry, saying which host this is.
      Type only, fixed top-left, no chip or border — the mark is shared/_brand_mark
      there and cannot be rendered from here (MASTER/web does not mount the engine),
      so it is the same markup and the same class names rather than a second design.
      <header> because it is page content that would otherwise sit outside any
      landmark, which is what axe flagged on the RAILS side. %>
  <header>
    <% mark = "ai.brgen.no" %>
    <a class="brand-mark" href="/" aria-label="<%= t("nav.brand_home", default: mark) %>">
      <span class="brand-text"><%= mark %></span>
    </a>
  </header>
  <div id="error-live" class="sr-only" aria-live="assertive" aria-atomic="true"></div>
  <div id="ascii-star" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <canvas id="cognition-ecology" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <canvas id="face" role="img" aria-label="<%= t("face.face_aria") %>" tabindex="-1"></canvas>
  <%# Mic state, always on screen. It used to be a 10px dot at opacity 0 that
      appeared only while listening, so "off" and "not rendered" looked
      identical and the only way to learn the mic was off was to talk and get
      nothing. Grey glyph when idle, live colour when listening.
      role=status rather than aria-hidden: this is now the only indication of
      whether the microphone is open, which is not something to hide from a
      screen reader. %>
  <div id="mic-dot" class="mic-indicator" role="status"
       aria-label="<%= t("face.mic_state") %>">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
      <path d="M12 3a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v6a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V6a3 3 0 0 0-3-3z"/>
      <path d="M5 11a7 7 0 0 0 14 0" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M12 18v3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </svg>
    <span class="sr-only" data-mic-state-text></span>
  </div>
  <div id="tts-live" class="sr-only" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></div>
  <%# Small synchronous prerequisite: every deferred ecology/worker module and
      the post-primer face import may assume window.ParticleKernel exists. %>
  <script src="<%= asset_path("particle_kernel.js") %>"></script>
  <div id="primer" role="button" aria-labelledby="primer-title" aria-describedby="primer-capabilities primer-consent" tabindex="0"
       data-i18n-starting="<%= t("face.starting") %>"
       data-i18n-loading-title="<%= t("face.loading_title") %>"
       data-i18n-loading-status="<%= t("face.loading_status") %>"
       data-i18n-still-loading="<%= t("face.still_loading") %>"
       data-i18n-retrying="<%= t("face.retrying") %>"
       data-i18n-failed="<%= t("face.failed") %>"
       data-i18n-failed-live="<%= t("face.failed_live") %>">
    <h1 id="primer-title"><%= t("face.primer_title") %></h1>
    <p class="tagline" id="primer-capabilities"><%= t("face.primer_capabilities") %></p>
    <p class="primer-consent" id="primer-consent"><%= t("face.primer_consent") %></p>
  </div>
  <%# The mic opens at load: face.part5 says why, and how a denied permission
      or a deliberate exit keeps it shut. %>
  <%# Boot + primer tap must run synchronously right after #primer — before ANY other
      script (including face_2d_fallback). A blocking <script src> above this line delays
      handler wiring; early taps look dead. #zsh and #ui-status are below this block —
      resolve them lazily in go(), not at parse time.
      See CLAUDE.md and history of "tap to start does nothing" for this high-risk path.
      Enhancements here should preserve the _primerFired guard and dbgFrames check. %>
  <script src="<%= asset_path("boot_fsm.js") %>"></script>
  <script nonce="<%= content_security_policy_nonce %>">
    window.MASTER_CACHE_VERSION = <%= ENV.fetch("CACHE_VERSION", "v2").to_json.html_safe %>;
    (function(){
      var p=document.getElementById('primer');
      var fired=false,timer=null,fallback=null,hintT=null,retryT=null,started=false,failedShown=false;
      function zshEl(){return document.getElementById('zsh');}
      function uiEl(){return document.getElementById('ui-status');}
      function titleEl(){return document.getElementById('primer-title');}
      function i18n(key, fallback, vars){
        var raw=(p&&p.getAttribute('data-i18n-'+key))||fallback;
        if(!vars)return raw;
        return raw.replace(/%\{(\w+)\}/g,function(_,name){return vars[name]});
      }
      function primeAudio(){
        try{
          var Ctx=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
          if(!Ctx||window.__MASTER_AUDIO_PRIME__)return;
          var ctx=new Ctx();
          window.__MASTER_AUDIO_PRIME__=ctx;
          ctx.resume().catch(function(){});
        }catch(_e){}
      }
      function dismissPrimer(){
        document.body.classList.remove('face-loading');
        if(!p)return;
        p.classList.add('gone');
        window.setTimeout(function(){p.remove();},220);
      }
      function revealPrompt(){
        var z=zshEl(),ui=uiEl();
        if(z)z.classList.add('live');
        if(ui&&!ui.textContent)ui.textContent=i18n('starting','starting…');
        // Keyboard users: land focus in the prompt after primer dismiss.
        var zin=document.getElementById('zin');
        if(zin){try{zin.focus({preventScroll:true});}catch(_e){try{zin.focus();}catch(__e){}}}
      }
      function boot(){
        if(started)return true;
        if(window.MASTER_FACE&&window.MASTER_FACE.startEverything){
          started=true;
          window.MASTER_FACE.startEverything();
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      }
      function clearWatch(){
        clearTimeout(hintT);clearTimeout(retryT);clearTimeout(fallback);
        clearInterval(timer);timer=null;
        if(typeof window.stop2DFallback==='function')window.stop2DFallback();
        var ui=uiEl();
        if(ui&&ui.dataset.bootLoading){ui.textContent='';delete ui.dataset.bootLoading;}
      }
      function bootFailed(){
        clearWatch();
        window.MASTER?.boot?.transition?.('ERROR', { source: 'bootFailed' });
        fallbackUi();
      }
      function showProgress(pct){
        var n=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.round(pct)));
        var title=titleEl(),ui=uiEl();
        if(title)title.textContent=i18n('loading-title','loading… %{n}%',{n:n});
        if(ui){ui.dataset.bootLoading='1';ui.textContent=i18n('loading-status','loading face %{n}%',{n:n});}
      }
      function showLoadState(){showProgress(0);}
      function fallbackUi(){
        dismissPrimer();
        revealPrompt();
        var ui=uiEl();
        if(ui)ui.textContent=i18n('failed','face failed to load — reload or check console');
        var errLive=document.getElementById('error-live');
        if(errLive)errLive.textContent=i18n('failed-live','face failed to load (WebGL/primer timing?). Reload or see browser console for MASTER_FACE errors.');
        failedShown=true;
      }
      // A face that paints after the watchdog gave up has disproved the
      // announcement, and a screen reader must not keep the false one.
      addEventListener('master:face-ready',function(){
        if(!failedShown)return;
        failedShown=false;
        var ui=uiEl(),errLive=document.getElementById('error-live');
        if(ui)ui.textContent='';
        if(errLive)errLive.textContent='';
      });
      function resetFaceCanvasForWebGL(){
        var cv=document.getElementById('face');
        if(!cv||!cv.parentNode)return;
        var fresh=cv.cloneNode(false);
        cv.parentNode.replaceChild(fresh,cv);
      }
      function loadFace(retried){
        if(window.__MASTER_FACE_IMPORT__)return;
        window.__MASTER_FACE_IMPORT__=true;
        if(retried)window.MASTER?.boot?.transition?.('RECOVERING', { source: 'loadFace_retry' });
        window.MASTER?.boot?.transition?.('ASSETS', { source: 'loadFace', retried: !!retried });
        resetFaceCanvasForWebGL();
        import("<%= asset_path("face.js") %>").then(function(){
          if(boot())clearWatch();
        }).catch(function(){
          window.__MASTER_FACE_IMPORT__=false;
          if(retried){bootFailed();return;}
          var ui=uiEl();
          if(ui)ui.textContent=i18n('retrying','retrying…');
          window.MASTER?.boot?.transition?.('RECOVERING', { source: 'loadFace_catch' });
          retryT=setTimeout(function(){loadFace(true);},1200);
        });
      }
      function go(){
        if(fired)return;
        fired=true;
        window.MASTER?.boot?.transition?.('PRIMER', { source: 'primer_tap' });
        var title=titleEl();
        if(title)title.textContent=i18n('starting','starting…');
        window._primerFired=true;
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('primer:ready'));
        primeAudio();
        dismissPrimer();
        revealPrompt();
        if(typeof window.start2DFallback==='function')window.start2DFallback();
        loadFace();
        if(boot())return;
        showLoadState();
        var progPct=0;
        hintT=setTimeout(function(){var ui=uiEl();if(ui)ui.textContent=i18n('still-loading','still loading the face…');},8000);
        timer=setInterval(function(){
          if(boot()){clearWatch();return;}
          if(progPct<90){
            progPct+=0.5+Math.random()*1.5;
            showProgress(Math.min(progPct,90));
          }
        },40);
        fallback=setTimeout(function(){
          var f=window.MASTER_FACE;
          // primerFired only proves startEverything() ran, not that anything
          // painted - a WebGLRenderer that threw during construction (caught
          // and swallowed downstream) leaves primerFired true and the canvas
          // permanently black. dbgFrames only increments from inside a real
          // frame() call, so it's the actual evidence of rendering.
          if(f&&f.primerFired&&!window.__MASTER_RENDERER_FAILED__&&(f.dbgFrames>0||!f.renderer)){clearWatch();}else{bootFailed();}
        },35000);
      }
      window.__MASTER_PRIMER_GO__=go;
      window.__MASTER_PRIMER_TAP__=go;
      if(p){
        ['pointerdown','click','touchend'].forEach(function(ev){
          p.addEventListener(ev,go,{capture:true,passive:true});
        });
        p.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
          if(e.key===' '||e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();go();}
        });
      }
      addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
        if(!fired&&(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')){e.preventDefault();go();}
      });
      // Autostart is the default: no "launch AI" screen between the visitor and
      // the face. Embeds and ?autostart=1 already took this path, so this flips
      // which case is the exception rather than adding a new boot route — the
      // one below has been the exercised path for every front-page embed.
      // ?primer=1 keeps the old overlay for debugging the gesture path itself.
      //
      // What the tap did that a page load cannot: supply the user gesture an
      // AudioContext needs. primeAudio() now runs against a page that has had no
      // interaction, so the context is created 'suspended' and ctx.resume()
      // rejects. The listeners below resume it on the first real interaction —
      // any pointerdown or keydown, including the one that sends the first
      // prompt — so speech works from the first reply without a screen whose
      // only job was to collect a click.
      try{
        var q=new URLSearchParams(location.search||'');
        if(q.get('portrait')==='1') document.body.dataset.portrait='1';
        if(q.get('film')==='1') document.body.dataset.film='1';
        if(q.get('primer')!=='1'&&document.body.dataset.primer!=='keep'){
          document.body.classList.add('primer-autostart');
          if(p){p.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');p.tabIndex=-1;}
          setTimeout(go,0);

          var resumeAudio=function(){
            var ctx=window.__MASTER_AUDIO_PRIME__;
            if(ctx&&ctx.state==='suspended'){try{ctx.resume();}catch(_e){}}
            if(!ctx){primeAudio();return;}
            if(ctx.state==='running'){
              ['pointerdown','keydown','touchend'].forEach(function(ev){
                removeEventListener(ev,resumeAudio,{capture:true});
              });
            }
          };
          ['pointerdown','keydown','touchend'].forEach(function(ev){
            addEventListener(ev,resumeAudio,{capture:true,passive:true});
          });
        }
      }catch(_e){}
    })();
  </script>
  <script src="<%= asset_path("face_2d_fallback.js") %>" defer></script>
  <div class="ui-status sr-only" id="ui-status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></div>
  <div id="mood-live" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" class="sr-only"></div>
  <%# The prompt lives in main with the log it writes to: LAYOUT.md names #zin
      the face's main landmark target, and a form outside every landmark is
      content a screen reader's landmark list cannot reach. It is a form with
      a name, not a search, so it carries no role of its own (SEMANTIC_ELEMENTS). %>
  <main id="chat-shell" role="main" aria-label="<%= t("face.chat_aria") %>">
    <div id="chat-log" aria-live="polite" aria-relevant="additions text" tabindex="-1"></div>
    <form id="zsh" aria-label="<%= t("face.prompt_aria") %>" autocomplete="off">
      <button id="photo-button" type="button" aria-label="<%= t("face.attach_photo") %>">+</button>
      <input id="photo" type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment" hidden>
      <span class="pp" aria-hidden="true"><%= t("face.prompt_user") %></span><span class="sep2" aria-hidden="true">$ </span>
      <textarea id="zin" rows="1" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" autocorrect="off" spellcheck="false" enterkeyhint="send" placeholder="<%= t("face.placeholder") %>" aria-label="<%= t("face.message_aria") %>" required></textarea>
      <span id="zsh-status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></span>

      <button id="spin-btn" type="button" aria-label="<%= t("face.pause_speech") %>"></button>
    </form>
  </main>
  <script src="<%= asset_path("container_gate.js") %>" defer></script>
  <script src="<%= asset_path("face_deferred_loader.js") %>" defer></script>
  <%# Deferred boot modules, from config/face_assets.yml#shell_manifest — order is
      the boot contract. face.js (the THREE.js WebGL face) is intentionally absent:
      loadFace() imports it lazily on the primer tap (see the boot script above). %>
  <%= javascript_include_tag(*FaceAssets.group("shell_manifest"), defer: true) %>
  <script src="<%= asset_path("master_events.js") %>" defer></script>
  <script src="<%= asset_path("shortcut_sheet.js") %>" defer></script>
  <script src="<%= asset_path("viewport_inset.js") %>" defer></script>
  <script nonce="<%= content_security_policy_nonce %>">
    fetch('/runtime/config').then((r) => r.ok ? r.json() : null).then((cfg) => {
      if (cfg && typeof cfg === 'object') {
        window.MASTER_RUNTIME = { ...window.MASTER_RUNTIME, ...cfg };
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('master:runtime-config'));
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
  </script>
</body>
</html>

`````

### web/app/views/dashboard/index.html.erb

`````html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="<%= I18n.locale %>">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#000000">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
  <title><%= t("dashboard.title") %></title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/face.css">
</head>
<body class="mission-control" data-layout="document" data-surface="face" data-theme="dark">
  <a class="skip-link" href="#main-content"><%= t("skip_to_content") %></a>
  <header class="page-header" role="banner">
    <h1>
      <a href="/"><%= t("dashboard.heading_chat") %></a>
      <%= t("dashboard.heading_sep") %>
      <%= t("dashboard.heading_mission") %>
    </h1>
  </header>
  <main id="main-content" role="main" aria-label="<%= t("dashboard.main_label") %>">
    <div class="grid" id="mission-grid"
         data-i18n-loading="<%= t("dashboard.loading") %>"
         data-i18n-auth="<%= t("dashboard.auth_required") %>"
         data-i18n-none="<%= t("dashboard.empty_none") %>"
         data-i18n-empty="<%= t("dashboard.empty_empty") %>"
         data-i18n-quiet="<%= t("dashboard.empty_quiet") %>"
         data-i18n-breakers-none="<%= t("dashboard.status.breakers_none") %>"
         data-label-model="<%= t("dashboard.status.model") %>"
         data-label-ctx="<%= t("dashboard.status.ctx") %>"
         data-label-tokens="<%= t("dashboard.status.tokens") %>"
         data-label-cost="<%= t("dashboard.status.cost") %>"
         data-label-agent-pool="<%= t("dashboard.status.agent_pool") %>"
         data-label-breakers="<%= t("dashboard.status.breakers") %>"
         data-label-commands="<%= t("dashboard.rtk.commands") %>"
         data-label-saved="<%= t("dashboard.rtk.saved") %>"
         data-label-bytes="<%= t("dashboard.rtk.bytes") %>"
         data-label-band="<%= t("dashboard.pressure.band") %>"
         data-label-pct="<%= t("dashboard.pressure.pct") %>"
         data-label-headroom="<%= t("dashboard.pressure.headroom") %>"
         data-label-status="<%= t("dashboard.providers.status") %>"
         data-label-open-breakers="<%= t("dashboard.providers.open_breakers") %>">
      <div class="panel"><h2><%= t("dashboard.panels.status") %></h2><pre id="status" aria-live="polite"><%= t("dashboard.loading") %></pre></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2><%= t("dashboard.panels.rtk") %></h2><pre id="rtk" aria-live="polite"><%= t("dashboard.loading") %></pre></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2><%= t("dashboard.panels.plan") %></h2><pre id="plan" aria-live="polite"><%= t("dashboard.loading") %></pre></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2><%= t("dashboard.panels.rsi") %></h2><pre id="rsi" aria-live="polite"><%= t("dashboard.loading") %></pre></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2><%= t("dashboard.panels.skills") %></h2><pre id="skills" aria-live="polite"><%= t("dashboard.loading") %></pre></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2><%= t("dashboard.panels.pressure") %></h2><pre id="pressure" aria-live="polite"><%= t("dashboard.loading") %></pre></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2><%= t("dashboard.panels.providers") %></h2><pre id="providers" aria-live="polite"><%= t("dashboard.loading") %></pre></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2><%= t("dashboard.panels.repair") %></h2><pre id="repair" aria-live="polite"><%= t("dashboard.loading") %></pre></div>
      <div class="panel"><h2><%= t("dashboard.panels.bus") %></h2><pre id="bus" aria-live="polite"><%= t("dashboard.loading") %></pre></div>
    </div>
  </main>
  <script nonce="<%= content_security_policy_nonce %>">
    const grid = document.getElementById('mission-grid');
    const L = (key, fallback = '') => grid?.dataset[key] || fallback;

    // Without the operator token the page says so once and stops asking. Nine
    // panels reading "loading…" forever, re-fetched every 8s, is a closed door
    // that looks open (NO_DEAD_ENDS); the header's link back to the chat is
    // the open one beside it.
    function closeDoor() {
      clearInterval(timer);
      const note = document.createElement('p');
      note.textContent = L('i18nAuth', 'authentication required');
      grid.replaceChildren(note);
    }

    async function refresh() {
      const r = await fetch('/dashboard/live');
      if (r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) { closeDoor(); return; }
      const d = await r.json();
      if (d.error) { document.getElementById('status').textContent = d.error; return; }
      const none = L('i18nBreakersNone', 'none');
      const m = d.mission || {};
      document.getElementById('status').textContent = [
        `${L('labelModel', 'model')}: ${d.model}`,
        `mission: ${m.id || 'none'}`,
        `mission state: ${m.state || 'idle'} / ${m.stage || '—'}`,
        `effort: ${m.effort || '—'}`,
        `${L('labelCtx', 'ctx')}: ${d.tokens} ${L('labelTokens', 'tokens')}`,
        `${L('labelCost', 'cost')}: $${Number(d.cost || 0).toFixed(4)}`,
        `${L('labelAgentPool', 'agent pool')}: ${d.agent_pool} active`,
        `${L('labelBreakers', 'breakers')}: ${(d.open_breakers || []).join(', ') || none}`
      ].join('\n');
      const rtk = d.rtk || {};
      document.getElementById('rtk').textContent = [
        `${L('labelCommands', 'commands')}: ${rtk.commands || 0}`,
        `${L('labelSaved', 'saved')}: ${rtk.saved_pct || 0}%`,
        `${L('labelBytes', 'bytes')}: ${rtk.bytes_out || 0} / ${rtk.bytes_in || 0}`
      ].join('\n');
      document.getElementById('plan').textContent = d.active_plan || L('i18nNone', '(none)');
      document.getElementById('rsi').textContent = (d.rsi_inbox || []).map(i => `${i.path}\n${i.excerpt}`).join('\n\n') || L('i18nEmpty', '(empty)');
      document.getElementById('skills').textContent = (d.skills || []).join('\n') || L('i18nNone', '(none)');
      const p = d.context_pressure || {};
      document.getElementById('pressure').textContent = [
        `${L('labelBand', 'band')}: ${p.band || 'ok'}`,
        `${L('labelTokens', 'tokens')}: ${p.tokens || 0} / ${p.limit || 0}`,
        `${L('labelPct', 'pct')}: ${p.pct || 0}%`,
        `${L('labelHeadroom', 'headroom')}: ${p.headroom || 0}`
      ].join('\n');
      const ph = d.provider_health || {};
      document.getElementById('providers').textContent = [
        `${L('labelStatus', 'status')}: ${ph.status || 'unknown'}`,
        `${L('labelOpenBreakers', 'open breakers')}: ${(ph.open_breakers || []).join(', ') || none}`,
        `${L('labelAgentPool', 'agent pool')}: ${ph.agent_pool || 0}`
      ].join('\n');
      document.getElementById('repair').textContent = (d.repair_queue || []).map((item) => {
        const recent = (item.recent || []).join('\n  ');
        return `${item.path} (${item.count || 0} bytes)\n  ${recent}`;
      }).join('\n\n') || L('i18nEmpty', '(empty)');
      document.getElementById('bus').textContent = (d.bus_events || []).slice(-12).map(e => JSON.stringify(e)).join('\n') || L('i18nQuiet', '(quiet)');
    }
    const timer = setInterval(refresh, 8000);
    refresh();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

`````

### web/app/views/pwa/manifest.json.erb

`````html
<%#
  The one manifest. public/manifest.json held this content as a static file,
  and a file in public/ is served before the router reaches this template, so
  pwa#manifest and this view answered nothing -- the richer static copy won
  every request while this one drifted. Deleting the file is what makes the
  route real, and the route is what lets the manifest vary by host.
%>{
  "name": "MASTER",
  "short_name": "MASTER",
  "description": "Public MASTER chat",
  "start_url": "/",
  "scope": "/",
  "display": "fullscreen",
  "display_override": ["fullscreen", "window-controls-overlay", "standalone"],
  "edge_side_panel": {
    "preferred_width": 400
  },
  "launch_handler": {
    "client_mode": "navigate-new"
  },
  "orientation": "any",
  "background_color": "#030303",
  "theme_color": "#030303",
  "icons": [
    { "src": "/icon.svg", "sizes": "any",     "type": "image/svg+xml" },
    { "src": "/icon.png", "sizes": "192x192", "type": "image/png" },
    { "src": "/icon.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "any maskable" }
  ],
  "shortcuts": [
    { "name": "Chat", "short_name": "Chat", "url": "/", "description": "Open MASTER chat" },
    { "name": "Focus face", "short_name": "Focus", "url": "/?focus=1", "description": "Face-only focus mode" },
    { "name": "Mission control", "short_name": "Dashboard", "url": "/dashboard", "description": "Runtime observability" }
  ]
}
`````

### web/config/application.rb

`````ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative "boot"

require "rails"
# Pick the frameworks you want:
require "active_model/railtie"
# require "active_job/railtie"
require "active_record/railtie"
# require "active_storage/engine"

# Require the gems listed in Gemfile, including any gems
# you've limited to :test, :development, or :production.
Bundler.require(*Rails.groups)

require_relative "../app/services/operator_token"
require_relative "../app/middleware/auth_tier"
require_relative "../app/middleware/html_no_store"
require_relative "../app/middleware/security_headers"

class ServiceWorkerNoCache
  def initialize(app) = @app = app

  def call(env)
    status, headers, body = @app.call(env)
    headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate" if env["PATH_INFO"] == "/sw.js"
    [status, headers, body]
  end
end

module Web
  class Application < Rails::Application
    # Initialize configuration defaults for originally generated Rails version.
    config.load_defaults 8.2

    # Please, add to the `ignore` list any other `lib` subdirectories that do
    # not contain `.rb` files, or that should not be reloaded or eager loaded.
    # Common ones are `templates`, `generators`, or `middleware`, for example.
    config.autoload_lib(ignore: %w[assets tasks master])
    # Face sources live in public/; never treat digest output (public/assets/) as input.
    config.assets.paths << Rails.root.join("public")
    config.assets.excluded_paths << Rails.root.join("public", "assets")

    # Configuration for the application, engines, and railties goes here.
    #
    # These settings can be overridden in specific environments using the files
    # in config/environments, which are processed later.
    #
    # config.time_zone = "Central Time (US & Canada)"
    # config.eager_load_paths << Rails.root.join("extras")

    # nb is the default because ai.brgen.no is the only host relayd forwards
    # here, and it is the same Norwegian audience brgen, amber and bsdports all
    # default to nb for. ApplicationController#set_locale hands English back to a
    # browser that asks for it — the face answers whoever reaches it, and a
    # Norwegian frame around an English conversation is worse than either.
    #
    # The fallback is what makes nb safe to switch on: a key nb has not got yet
    # renders its English rather than translation_missing. It is also what makes
    # nb/en parity worth enforcing in web/test/locale_contract_test.rb, since
    # a gap is invisible at runtime by design. The RAILS contract of the same
    # name does not see this app.
    config.i18n.default_locale = :nb
    config.i18n.available_locales = %i[nb en]
    config.i18n.fallbacks = { nb: :en }

    # Don't generate system test files.
    config.generators.system_tests = nil

    config.middleware.insert_before ActionDispatch::Static, ServiceWorkerNoCache

    config.middleware.use(
      AuthTier,
      config_path: -> { OperatorToken.config_path },
    )
    config.middleware.insert_before Rack::ETag, SecurityHeaders
    config.middleware.insert_before Rack::ETag, HtmlNoStore
  end
end
`````

`````ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "active_support/core_ext/integer/time"

Rails.application.configure do
  # Settings specified here will take precedence over those in config/application.rb.

  # Make code changes take effect immediately without server restart.
  config.enable_reloading = true

  # Do not eager load code on boot.
  config.eager_load = false

  # Show full error reports.
  config.consider_all_requests_local = true

  # Enable server timing.
  config.server_timing = true

  # Enable/disable Action Controller caching. By default Action Controller caching is disabled.
  # Run rails dev:cache to toggle Action Controller caching.
  if Rails.root.join("tmp/caching-dev.txt").exist?
    config.action_controller.perform_caching = true
    config.action_controller.enable_fragment_cache_logging = true
    config.public_file_server.headers = { "cache-control" => "public, max-age=#{2.days.to_i}" }
  else
    config.action_controller.perform_caching = false
  end

  # Change to :null_store to avoid any caching.
  config.cache_store = :memory_store

  # Print deprecation notices to the Rails logger.
  config.active_support.deprecation = :log

  # Raise an error on page load if there are pending migrations.
  config.active_record.migration_error = :page_load

  # Highlight code that triggered database queries in logs.
  config.active_record.verbose_query_logs = true

  # Append comments with runtime information tags to SQL queries in logs.
  config.active_record.query_log_tags_enabled = true

  # Highlight code that triggered redirect in logs.
  config.action_dispatch.verbose_redirect_logs = true

  # Suppress logger output for asset requests.
  config.assets.quiet = true

  # Raises error for missing translations.
  # config.i18n.raise_on_missing_translations = true

  # Annotate rendered view with file names.
  config.action_view.annotate_rendered_view_with_filenames = true

  # Raise error when a before_action's only/except options reference missing actions.
  config.action_controller.raise_on_missing_callback_actions = true

  # The hosts this app answers to in production. Development's default allow
  # list is localhost only, so probing the local server with a real Host header
  # -- the only way to exercise anything that varies by host -- got a
  # blocked-host page instead of the page under test. A pattern rather than a
  # list: config runs before autoloading, so it cannot ask a service which
  # hosts it claims, and a hand-kept list here would drift from the ones that
  # do.
  # The port is part of the Host header a browser sends to a non-443 local
  # server, and Regexp entries are matched against it whole -- so without
  # the optional group a real browser gets the blocked-host page while curl
  # with a hand-written Host header does not.
  config.hosts << /\A([a-z0-9-]+\.)*brgen\.no(:\d+)?\z/i
end

`````

### web/config/environments/production.rb

`````ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "active_support/core_ext/integer/time"

Rails.application.configure do
  # Settings specified here will take precedence over those in config/application.rb.

  # Same pin as RAILS production_baseline: YJIT is off on this box on purpose.
  config.yjit = false if config.respond_to?(:yjit=)

  # Code is not reloaded between requests.
  config.enable_reloading = false

  # Master gem uses manual require_relative for nested modules; eager_load trips Zeitwerk.
  # Falcon boots /up immediately; Master.bootstrap_container loads the agent stack lazily.
  config.eager_load = false

  # Full error reports are disabled.
  config.consider_all_requests_local = false

  # Turn on fragment caching in view templates.
  config.action_controller.perform_caching = true

  # Cache assets for far-future expiry since they are all digest stamped.
  config.public_file_server.headers = { "cache-control" => "public, max-age=#{1.year.to_i}" }

  # Enable serving of images, stylesheets, and JavaScripts from an asset server.
  # config.asset_host = "http://assets.example.com"

  # Assume all access to the app is happening through a SSL-terminating reverse proxy.
  config.assume_ssl = true

  # SSL terminated at relayd proxy layer — do not redirect internally.
  config.force_ssl = false

  # Skip http-to-https redirect for the default health check endpoint.
  # config.ssl_options = { redirect: { exclude: ->(request) { request.path == "/up" } } }

  # Log to STDOUT with the current request id as a default log tag.
  config.log_tags = [ :request_id ]
  STDOUT.sync   = true
  config.logger = ActiveSupport::TaggedLogging.logger(STDOUT)

  # Change to "debug" to log everything (including potentially personally-identifiable information!).
  config.log_level = ENV.fetch("RAILS_LOG_LEVEL", "info")

  # Prevent health checks from clogging up the logs.
  config.silence_healthcheck_path = "/up"

  # Don't log any deprecations.
  config.active_support.report_deprecations = false

  # Replace the default in-process memory cache store with a durable alternative.
  # config.cache_store = :mem_cache_store

  # Enable locale fallbacks for I18n (makes lookups for any locale fall back to
  # the I18n.default_locale when a translation cannot be found).
  config.i18n.fallbacks = true

  # Do not dump schema after migrations.
  config.active_record.dump_schema_after_migration = false

  # Only use :id for inspections in production.
  config.active_record.attributes_for_inspect = [ :id ]

  # Any Host is accepted because the allow-list sits one hop earlier: Falcon binds loopback only,
  # relayd forwards only Host: ai.brgen.no to it, and unmatched hosts go to brgen.
  config.host_authorization = { exclude: ->(request) { true } }
end

`````

### web/config/face_assets.yml

`````yaml
---
# The one list of every JavaScript asset the chat shell loads for the face.
#
# Before this file, chat/index.html.erb named them four different ways — a
# MASTER_ASSET_PATHS object literal, individual <script src> tags, a
# javascript_include_tag list of *bare names* (no .js), and the face.runtime.js
# blob — and no single place enumerated the set. Two consequences:
#
#   * /etc/rc.d/master's precompile-skip digest covers ~10 named files and
#     silently misses the other ~30, so editing one and restarting keeps a stale
#     fingerprint (see web/CLAUDE.md).
#   * grep face_state.js finds nothing, because the include_tag writes
#     face_state. A file can look dead and be live.
#
# Order within each group is load order and is part of the boot contract. Read
# the group comments before moving anything between them.

# Three files touch particles and three touch the ecology; each has one job and
# boots in a different group below.
#
#   particles  particle_kernel.js (shell_blocking) defines window.ParticleKernel,
#              the cell pool. particle_worker.js (shell_manifest) is the Worker
#              that steps a transferred pool off the main thread. face_particles.js
#              (face_eager) builds the step context from face State after the tap.
#              gravity_field.js (face_eager) is the ambient Antigravity-style
#              constellation: deterministic shell, spring return and local pointer field.
#   ecology    cognition_ecology.js (face_vision_deferred) owns the 2D canvas and
#              window.MASTEREcology; cognition_ecology_render.js draws it, loaded
#              straight after. face_offscreen_ecology.js (face_eager) moves that
#              buffer to an OffscreenCanvas where the browser has one, and returns
#              early when MASTEREcology is not up yet.

# Imported eagerly by public/face.js immediately after the primer tap, in this
# order. particle_kernel consumers must not precede attention_model.
face_eager:
  - attention_model.js
  - face_particles.js
  - face_audio_bridge.js
  - face_tts_bridge.js
  - face_expression_bridge.js
  - face_blendshape_bridge.js
  - face_council_multi.js
  - face_phosphor_trail.js
  - face_offscreen_ecology.js
  - face_micro_interactions.js
  - face_perf_guards.js
  - face_brutalist.js
  - gravity_field.js

# Imported lazily from the tail of face.part5.txt via _deferFaceMod(), after the
# face itself is up.
face_runtime_deferred:
  - face_semantics.js
  - face_minimal_ui.js
  - face_loops_music.js
  - face_loops_nudge.js
  # Opt-in semantic endpointing. The module is small; the 21MB it can fetch
  # (WASM runtime + ONNX model) is not fetched until it is switched on.
  - smart_turn.js

# Loaded by public/face_deferred_loader.js once it sees primer:ready — a second,
# independent layer from the core face runtime.
face_vision_deferred:
  - face_vision.bundle.js
  - cognition_ecology.js
  - cognition_ecology_render.js
  # The gl.POINTS half of the same world. It asks for a WebGL context the moment
  # it runs, so it belongs in this group and no earlier: the deferred loader
  # waits for primer:ready, which is the only point at which the shell's
  # getContext gate stops returning null.
  - face_points_gl.js

# Non-module assets addressed by name in MASTER_ASSET_PATHS.
singletons:
  threeModule: three.face.module.js
  faceVisionBundle: face_vision.bundle.js
  faceAvatar: face_avatar.png
  faceRuntime: face.runtime.js
  visemePacks: viseme_packs.json
  clusterMiner: cluster_miner.js

# Synchronous, and loaded before #primer: every deferred ecology/worker module
# and the post-primer face import may assume window.ParticleKernel already
# exists, so it cannot be deferred with the rest.
shell_blocking:
  - particle_kernel.js

# Synchronous, and loaded *after* #primer — which is why this is its own group
# rather than another shell_blocking entry, whose contract is before the primer.
# It sits immediately above the inline boot script so window.MASTER.boot exists
# for the whole tap path, and it installs listeners for master:face-ready and
# master:container-ready that must be armed before either can fire.
#
# It was the one asset the view loaded that this file did not name, allowlisted
# out of the every script the view loads is in the manifest test. That is the
# hole the manifest exists to close: rc.d's precompile-skip digest enumerates
# this file through script/face_asset_paths.rb, so an undeclared module could be
# edited and restarted with precompile silently skipped and the stale
# fingerprint still live.
shell_boot:
  - boot_fsm.js

# Plain <script defer> tags in the shell. These stay written out literally in
# index.html.erb rather than rendered from here: their positions differ and
# are load-bearing — face_2d_fallback sits after the inline boot script so it
# cannot delay tap wiring, and a test pins that ordering. Listed here so the set
# is still enumerable; a contract test asserts the view and this file agree.
shell_early:
  - face_2d_fallback.js
  - container_gate.js
  - face_deferred_loader.js

# javascript_include_tag, deferred, in this order. Written as bare names because
# that is what the tag takes; every entry is a real public/<name>.js.
#
# felt_state leads: it installs the master:visual/master:emotion listeners that
# make it the presence store, and visual_bridge below starts emitting both on
# load. It was undeclared and therefore never loaded at all, which left
# window.MASTERFeltState undefined — so chat_actions own send path dropped the
# felt state from every message and logged invalid felt state payload instead,
# and face_vision felt_state rule read an empty string forever.
shell_manifest:
  - felt_state
  - ui_presence
  - face_state
  - visual_governor
  - topology_registry
  - particle_worker
  - sse_contract
  - chat_actions
  - visual_bridge
  - chat
  - master_namespace

# Trailing <script defer> tags, after the ordered manifest.
shell_late:
  - master_events.js
  - shortcut_sheet.js
  - viewport_inset.js

# Stylesheets the shell links by asset_path. Not JavaScript, but digested the
# same way, so rc.d precompile-skip digest has to see an edit to them too.
shell_css:
  - face.css
  - chat_upload.css

`````

### web/config/initializers/booted_sha.rb

`````ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "open3"

# The commit this process booted, read once at boot. A `git pull` on vm23 moves
# HEAD without restarting Falcon, so /health reading HEAD per request named code
# the process was not running — and deploy.git_sha exists to answer exactly that.
#
# -c safe.directory because the daemon runs as `master` and the checkout belongs
# to `dev`; HealthController#git_healthy? carries the same flag for the same reason.
Rails.application.config.x.booted_sha = begin
  repo = Rails.root.join("..").to_s
  out, status = Open3.capture2("git", "-c", "safe.directory=#{repo}", "-C", repo,
                               "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD", err: File::NULL)
  status.success? ? out.strip.freeze : nil
rescue SystemCallError # scan: intentional — no git binary means no provenance, and /health reports null
  nil
end

`````

### web/config/initializers/content_security_policy.rb

`````ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Restart server after editing.
Rails.application.configure do
  config.content_security_policy_nonce_generator = ->(_request) { SecureRandom.base64(16) }
  config.content_security_policy_nonce_directives = %w[script-src]

  embed_hosts = ENV.fetch(
    "MASTER_FRAME_ANCESTORS",
    "https://brgen.no https://www.brgen.no https://amberapp.art",
  ).split

  config.content_security_policy do |policy|
    policy.default_src :self
    policy.font_src :self, :data
    policy.img_src :self, :data
    policy.object_src :none
    policy.script_src :self, :blob
    # unsafe_inline stays: the FOUC guard is an inline style by design, and a nonce there moves
    # colours the operator owns.
    policy.style_src :self, :unsafe_inline
    policy.connect_src :self
    policy.media_src :self, :blob
    policy.frame_src :none
    policy.frame_ancestors :self, *embed_hosts
  end

  enforce = ENV["PUB4_CSP_ENFORCE"] == "1"
  config.content_security_policy_report_only = !enforce
end

`````

### web/config/initializers/master_container.rb

`````ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

Rails.application.config.x.master_start_ms = (Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) * 1000).to_i
Rails.application.config.x.master_container = nil
Rails.application.config.x.master_container_mutex = Mutex.new
Rails.application.config.x.master_bootstrap_started = false

# The test suite stubs the container in its setup. A real one built at boot
# lands on config.x whenever its thread finishes, over whatever stub the test
# then running installed, so a test of the warming path would read a live
# container or not depending on how long the boot took.
Rails.application.config.after_initialize do
  next if MasterContainerLoader.asset_task?

  MasterContainerLoader.warm_shared_namespace!
  MasterContainerLoader.rearm! unless Rails.env.test?
end

module MasterContainerLoader
  module_function

  # assets:precompile boots the whole app to resolve helpers, and it is not a
  # server -- nothing will ever serve a request from it. Building a container
  # there costs a container nobody uses and leaves a tts-worker daemon behind
  # for every precompile, which is why rc_pre kept accumulating orphaned
  # workers.
  #
  # It is not why master would not start. That was the master_web_assets gate
  # refusing on face.css :root drift, which rc_pre logs to syslog while rcctl
  # prints nothing -- so the refusal read as a hang. spawn_daemon already
  # redirects the child's stdio to a log and passes close_others, so no worker
  # ever held rc.d's pipe. Recorded because the first explanation here said it
  # did, and a wrong reason in a comment outlives the bug it misdescribes.
  def asset_task?
    ARGV.any? { |arg| arg.start_with?("assets:") }
  end

  # Master::Ground is loaded here, on the main thread, before the bootstrap
  # thread below exists.
  #
  # Master carries its own Zeitwerk loader and never eager-loads, so its
  # constants resolve by autoload on first reference. Zeitwerk autoloading is
  # not thread-safe, and the web tier arranges the one collision that matters:
  # ApplicationController names Master::Ground::Tool::Profile in its class body,
  # which Rails evaluates on the first request — inside the window where the
  # bootstrap thread is autoloading Master constants of its own. The collision
  # surfaces as `uninitialized constant Master::Ground::Tool::Profile`, and it
  # takes out any request that lands in the window, including a warming probe.
  #
  # 160 ms for the namespace, once, against a container bootstrap measured in
  # seconds. Eager-loading all of Master would cost 941 ms and delay /up, which
  # is the thing the bootstrap thread exists to avoid.
  def warm_shared_namespace!
    Master::LOADER.eager_load_namespace(Master::Ground)
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.warn("master_container: could not warm Master::Ground: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
  end

  # Arms the one bootstrap thread, and is safe to call on every request that
  # finds no container. The flag is claimed under the mutex so a burst of
  # requests during the ~40s boot starts one thread between them, not one each.
  #
  # ApplicationController#require_container! calls this. It used to be a stub
  # returning nil, on the grounds that the initializer owned the thread -- so
  # there was exactly one attempt per process and no way back from a lost one.
  def rearm!(config = Rails.application.config)
    return config.x.master_container if config.x.master_container

    claimed = config.x.master_container_mutex.synchronize do
      next false if config.x.master_bootstrap_started

      config.x.master_bootstrap_started = true
    end
    Thread.new { ensure! } if claimed
    nil
  end

  # The asset-task guard sits here as well as in after_initialize because every
  # path to a container ends in ensure!, including rearm! from
  # ApplicationController, so the guard cannot be walked around. rc_pre
  # runs assets:precompile as root, so a container built there spawns
  # tts-worker as root and leaves .master/tts-worker-*.log root-owned, which
  # the master user then cannot write.
  def ensure!(config = Rails.application.config)
    return if asset_task?
    return config.x.master_container if config.x.master_container

    config.x.master_container_mutex.synchronize do
      return config.x.master_container if config.x.master_container

      root = Rails.root.join("..").to_s
      Master.prepare_runtime!
      Master::Voice::TtsSupervisor.ensure_daemon!(root:)
      TtsJob.ensure_worker!
      container = Master.bootstrap_container(root:)
      config.x.master_container = container
      start_scheduler(container)
      Rails.logger.info("master_container: ready")
      container
    end
  # The bootstrap thread has no caller to report an exception to. Keep the
  # failure visible in the Rails log and release the claim so the next request
  # can rearm the container. StandardError is the application failure boundary;
  # process-level exceptions must still terminate the process rather than being
  # swallowed by a background thread.
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error("master_container boot failed: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
    config.x.master_bootstrap_started = false
    nil
  end

  def start_scheduler(container)
    return if defined?(@scheduler_started) && @scheduler_started

    @scheduler_started = true
    Thread.new do
      sleep 300
      loop do
        due = container[:standing].due
        if due.any?
          results = container[:standing].run_due!
          results.each do |r|
            Master::Ground::Swallow.safe_call(context: "MasterContainerLoader.scheduler_publish", event_bus: container[:bus]) do
              container[:bus].publish("scheduler:ran", name: r[:name])
            end
          end
        end
        sleep 900
      rescue StandardError => e
        Master::Ground::Swallow.log(e, context: "MasterContainerLoader.scheduler", event_bus: container[:bus])
      end
    end
  end
end

`````

`````ruby
Rails.application.routes.draw do
`````

### web/db/migrate/20260727130000_create_solid_cable_messages.rb

`````ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# MASTER/web had no migrations and no db/schema.rb at all, while config/cable.yml
# selects `adapter: solid_cable` for both development and production. Solid Cable
# is database-backed, so every ActionCable broadcast on ai.brgen.no was writing to
# a table that does not exist. Nothing caught it because:
#
#   * test env uses `adapter: test`, so the cable path is never exercised there;
#   * and the four Ruby test files could not run at all — without a schema.rb,
#     maintain_test_schema aborts the whole suite before the first test.
#
# Columns and indexes are copied from the gem's own installer template
# (solid_cable-3.0.12 lib/generators/solid_cable/install/templates/db/cable_schema.rb)
# rather than invented. Note `created_at` only — Solid Cable has no updated_at,
# so this deliberately does not use t.timestamps.
#
# cable.yml declares no `connects_to`, so Solid Cable uses the primary database
# and the table belongs in the primary schema.
class CreateSolidCableMessages < ActiveRecord::Migration[8.1]
  def change
    create_table :solid_cable_messages do |t|
      t.binary :channel, limit: 1024, null: false
      t.binary :payload, limit: 536_870_912, null: false
      t.datetime :created_at, null: false
      t.integer :channel_hash, limit: 8, null: false
    end

    add_index :solid_cable_messages, :channel
    add_index :solid_cable_messages, :channel_hash
    add_index :solid_cable_messages, :created_at
  end
end

`````

### web/lib/tasks/assets_hygiene.rake

`````ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# public/assets must die before it is rebuilt. application.rb's
# excluded_paths line claims digest output is never input, but Propshaft
# does not exclude a SUBDIRECTORY of an included path — public/ is the load
# path and public/assets sits inside it, so every precompile re-digested
# the previous run's output (face-09726ccc-09726ccc.css on vm23, 27 stale
# face copies locally, and the rc script's rm -rf of assets/assets is a
# band-aid over the same defect). Clobber-first is SAFE here and only
# here: every MASTER/web asset source lives in public/ (that is the face's
# design), so the digested tree is fully regenerable — this is NOT the
# brgen situation, where clobber once broke a page whose asset existed
# only precompiled.
Rake::Task["assets:precompile"].enhance(["assets:clobber"]) if Rake::Task.task_defined?("assets:precompile")

`````

### web/lib/tasks/face_modules_bundle.rake

`````ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

namespace :assets do
  desc "Build public/face.modules.bundle.js (single request for face module boot)"
  task build_face_modules_bundle: :environment do
    script = Rails.root.join("script/build_face_modules.sh")
    raise "missing #{script}" unless File.file?(script)

    system(script.to_s, exception: true)
    out = Rails.root.join("public/face.modules.bundle.js")
    raise "build_face_modules.sh did not write #{out}" unless File.file?(out)

    puts "wrote #{out} (#{File.size(out)} bytes)"
  end
end

if Rake::Task.task_defined?("assets:precompile")
  Rake::Task["assets:precompile"].enhance(["assets:build_face_modules_bundle"])
end

`````

### web/lib/tasks/face_runtime.rake

`````ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

namespace :assets do
  desc "Build public/face.runtime.js from face.part*.txt (skips blob assembly in browser)"
  # The segments stay in public/, as face_vision_a.js to face_vision_d.js do for
  # script/build_face_vision.sh: both builds and test_face_runtime_matches_its_sources read them
  # there, and serving a source file gives a visitor nothing the bundle does not.
  task build_face_runtime: :environment do
    out = Rails.root.join("public/face.runtime.js")
    segments = (1..3).map { |part| Rails.root.join("public", "face.part#{part}.txt") }
    segments << Rails.root.join("public", "face_speech_runtime.js")
    segments << Rails.root.join("public", "face_speech_playback.js")
    segments << Rails.root.join("public", "face.part5.txt")
    source = segments.map do |path|
      raise "missing #{path}" unless File.file?(path)

      File.read(path)
    end.join("\n")

    banner = <<~JS
      // Generated by rails assets:build_face_runtime — do not edit by hand.
      // Import map + MASTER_ASSET_PATHS resolve tail module imports at runtime.
    JS

    File.write(out, "#{banner}#{source}\n")
    puts "wrote #{out} (#{File.size(out)} bytes)"
  end
end

if Rake::Task.task_defined?("assets:precompile")
  Rake::Task["assets:precompile"].enhance(["assets:build_face_runtime"])
end

`````
